content: Jesudi mikme heki’walaŋ talitimeŋ diniŋ tipilapilaye-meŋiŋ tubukedebaguk
Jesu adi metam mede unduŋ yenindapmaaŋ Kafanaumde uguk.
Uŋoŋ mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋ wapum niŋ hatiluguk ala adi tipilapilaye-meŋiŋ momooŋ hinek timiluguk adi yagit kisaŋ tiŋa kumundegoŋ tuguk.
Kaŋ adi Jesu buguk u nadiŋa Judahi me wapuhidi wooŋ Jesu nimbune buŋa tipilapilaye mihiŋiŋ tubukedebadok yeniŋguk.
Kaŋ Judahi me wapuhi adi wooŋ Jesu baigoŋ hinek indiŋ ninadigiŋ, “Me u fofooŋ doktiŋa tubuloda hinek tibeŋ nadiyam.
Adi adi Judahi indi weleŋdi nibukahileeŋ bopyot niŋ manimguk.”
Unduŋ niŋa nagila noŋgoŋ ugiŋ wooŋ yot tubudulaune mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋdi mede indiŋ kameu uguk, “Wapum, nu me loloŋnit bale nu yotneneŋ beŋ?
Tiŋa nu aindiniŋ doktiŋa mu wooŋ gabuŋat, ale hogok uŋgoŋ hali mede hogok yobeŋ kaŋ tipilapilaye-mene kedem kedebawek.
Nu na maaŋ me wapum diniŋ falipmeŋ hatilatdi mikme uneŋ yenimbe wiiŋ, be buneŋ yenimbe biiŋ, be tipilapilaye-meneye nemek u tineŋ yenimbe tiiŋ doktiŋa ganilat.”
Unduŋ nimbu Jesudi mede u nadiŋa boho tiŋa metam keletaugiŋ indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nu nadisukiliti indiniŋ nemu kagut, Isilae kwetneŋ maaŋ nemu kagut.”
Unduŋ yobune me mede nai tiŋa bugiŋ u udaneeŋ yopmaŋ wooŋ kaune tipilapilaye-me agaŋ kedebaaŋ hakuk.
Jesudi tam kahat niŋ’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ kumuŋ gineniŋ tubukaikaguk
Muniniŋ hatigene Jesu yokwet wapum niŋ wou Nain uŋoŋ uguk. Kaŋ mihiŋiye tiŋa metam bop wapum noŋgoŋ keletiŋa ugiŋ.
Wooŋ yokwet wapum’walaŋ yeme gineŋ wosuwalune me dabaŋ niŋ wenene bem bugiŋ. Me kumuŋ tuguk u tam kahat niŋ’walaŋ mihi, tam kahat u mihiŋiŋ kubugoŋ-kabe uŋakoŋ doktiŋa metam fee noŋgoŋ bugiŋ.
Kaŋ Jesudi tam kahat u kaŋ bulaniŋgoŋ hinek nadimiŋa niŋguk, “Makat mu koleŋ.”
Unduŋ niŋa wooŋ bogit honeune me bogit bem ugiŋ adi uŋgoŋ yakiŋ kaŋ yoguk, “Mekuya, nu ganilat ale pilat.”
Unduŋ nimbune me dabaŋ u pilali ila mede yoguk, kaŋ Jesudi miŋ dut kotigoŋ hatidok niŋguk.
Unduŋ tubune metam hogohogok adi munta tiŋa Bepaŋ niŋa tiloloŋ tiŋa yogiŋ, “Polofet wapum adi kamiŋ indi’walaŋ iŋoŋ mintalak, Bepaŋ adi mehinekŋiye yehitubu-lodawe buguk.”
Unduŋ tubu gigitŋiŋdi kwetkwet hautaguk.
Jesu dut Jon’walaŋ mede
Kaŋ Jon mihiŋiye adi wooŋ nemenemek mintaguk u nimbu nadiŋa
meyat lufom yenimbu buune indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Wooŋ Wapum indiŋ ninadidemek, ‘Du Jondi me bubuŋdok yoguk ukube, be nolidok woomuyaneem?’”
Unduŋ yenimbu ugumuk wooŋ Jesu hakukneŋ wosuwaaŋ niŋgumuk, “Indi Jon Imeyout Tububihitdi mede indiŋ ganinadidim yoŋa ninimbu bumut, ‘Du me adi niniŋguk ukube, be nolidok woomuyaneem?’”
Unduŋ buŋa nimbune nai uŋaniŋgoŋ Jesudi metam yagit mebimebihinit be yabaphinit be dauhik sipmakahi yehitubu-kedebaaŋ meyat indiŋ yeniŋguk,

“Hidi udaneeŋ udemek. Wooŋ nemenemek mintaune kanadi tamuk u Jon nimbune nadiwek. Me dauhik sipmakahidi dauhik diwetom tiiŋ, kayohik kadakahidi talik yawiiŋ, wede hakihinitdi walandaiŋ, be magihik kaulehidi mede nadiiŋ, kumuŋ tigiŋ koti kaikaiŋ, agaŋ fiyewakahi Mede Momooŋ nadiiŋ.
Me nediyeŋ nu’walaŋ titiŋne kaŋ nadikadaka mu tilak adi Bepaŋdi kaune utumba tilak.”
Jon mihiŋiyat udaneeŋ ulune Jesudi metam Jondok indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi Jon kane kwet fiileŋ ugiŋ u maŋgoŋ kane ugiŋ? Hidi baniŋgip sububadi fedilu uŋambuŋat tilak ube kane ugiŋ?
Be me tinahukut kinonom tilak undiniŋbe kane ugiŋ? Me tinahukut undihi tinahukukiiŋ tiŋa momooŋ hatiiŋ adi mapme yohineŋ hogok hatiiŋ.
“Be polofet niŋ kane ugiŋ? Indiŋ hanimbe nadineŋ. Hidi me wooŋ kagiŋ adi yadi polofet noli yalakapme tilak, tiŋa adi yadi me uŋgoniŋ hinek.
Jondegoŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mededi indiŋ yolak,

content.text: ‘Nu kwanai-mene kamewe timeŋ wooŋ talik dobui tigambaak.’”

content: Unduŋ yoŋa tomboyoula indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Indiŋ hanilat, metam hogohogok kwetfoloŋ mintagiŋ nebek niŋdi Jon mu kalakapmeeŋ lolak, iŋgoŋ nebek Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebeŋ foloŋ Hatihati Kobuli gineŋ fofoŋnit-kabe hatilakdi Jon kalakapmeeŋ loloŋnit tilak.”
(Me takis moŋgomoŋgot tagiŋ tiŋa metam hogohogok, koom Jondi Imeyout tiyemguk adi Jesu’walaŋ mede nadiŋa yogiŋ, “Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede talii u didimeniŋ hinek.”
Iŋgoŋ Yodoko Mede hinale tiŋa Falisi heki adi Jondi Imeyout mu tinimbek yogiŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebet aditok gigit tuguk u kelekut tigiŋ.)
Kaŋ Jesudi indiŋ yoguk, “Metam kobuhi i maŋgoŋ diniŋ tuwolit kamekaaŋ yenimbit?
Adi yadi wapmihidok tuwolit. Wapmihi adi yowawaliweŋ bopneŋ haliŋa nohiyedok indiŋ yeniiŋ, ‘Indi kap momooŋ togumun iŋgoŋ nadifo mu tigiŋ, be kap bulaniŋgoŋ togumun iŋgoŋ makat mu kokiŋ.’
Jon Imeyout Tububihit ne adi buŋa nanaŋe kamehep tiŋa ime fafaŋeniŋ maaŋ mu naguk kaŋ ‘Me yabapnit’ niŋgiŋ.
Kaŋ Me Kobumuŋ adi buŋa nanaŋe ime naune kaŋ indiŋ yoiŋ ‘Me i nanaŋe molo tiŋa ime fafaŋeniŋ nanaŋ tilak doktiŋa me takis muneeŋ moŋgomoŋgot eŋ me kadakahi’walaŋ nohik.’
“Hidi unduŋ hati yoiŋ, iŋgoŋ metam Bepaŋ’walaaniŋ nadinadi moŋgokiiŋ adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ nadinadi wendok nadiune folooŋ hinek tilak unduŋ tubudakalenimiiŋ.”
Tam niŋ Jesu kayoŋ foloŋ haguwo munduŋnitdi yougomiŋguk
Tebele Jesu Falisi me niŋdi nanaŋe adut nanaŋdok niŋguk doktiŋa adi yolineŋ ugumuk.
Kaŋ yokwet uŋoŋ tam niŋ hatihatiŋiŋ kadakaniŋ hinek ala Jesu Falisi yolineŋ hatak nadiŋa ime munduŋ momooŋ toutŋiŋ kawadedi tigiŋ u tiŋa uguk.
Wooŋ Jesu sigiŋ gineŋ yali makat kolu dawi meeniŋdi Jesu kayoŋ foloŋ maaŋ youtelu ki hapmuŋdi kayoŋ tumolooŋ siŋgoŋgome tiŋa ime munduŋ momooŋdi yougomguk.
Kaŋ me Falisi Jesu nagi uguk adi indiŋ nadiŋa yakaguk. “Me i polofet biyagoŋ nobu kaŋ tam wehemit tilak i hatihatiŋiŋ kadakaniŋ u kedem kaŋ nadiluwek.”
Unduŋ ila nadiguk kaŋ Jesudi niŋguk, “Saimon, nu mede-kabe niŋ ganimbit.” Unduŋ nimbu Saimondibo yoguk, “Hinale, nemek u kedem nanimbeŋ.”
Unduŋ nimbune Jesudibo indiŋ niŋguk, “Meyat lufom adi me niŋ muneeŋ kibi kougoŋ tubu-udanemiŋdok yoŋa nimbu yemguk. Me noli 500 kina miŋguk agaŋ noli 50 kina miŋguk.
Kaŋ meyatdi muneeŋ kibikoŋ mu tubu-udanemiŋgumuk doktiŋa fiit wabi tuguk. Kaŋ meyat adi’walaaniŋ neeŋdi bomboŋgidok nadimimbune loloŋ hinek tuguk?”
Unduŋ nimbu Saimondi yoguk, “Me kadakaniŋŋiŋ wapum bimiŋgukdi.” Unduŋ yobune Jesudi yoguk, “U biyagoŋ.”
Unduŋ yoŋa udaneeŋ tam u kaŋ Saimon ninadiguk, “Tam i maaŋ be kaŋaŋ? Du yokeneŋ buŋat kaŋ kayone youtetdok ime nemu namuŋaŋ, kaŋ tam i dawi meeniŋdi kayone youtela ki hapmuŋdi tumoloŋak.
Du yokeneŋ bene nehisiŋgogome mu tiŋaŋ, iŋgoŋ tam i adi busuwa tiŋat uŋaniŋ kayone siŋgoŋgome tiŋak u mu wabiŋak.
Du kine foloŋ wel nemu yougomnamuŋaŋ iŋgoŋ adi yadi haguwo munduŋ momooŋdi kayone yougomnamuŋak.

Unduŋ doktiŋa indiŋ ganilat, adi weleŋdi nabukahile hinek tilak wondoktiŋa kadakaniŋŋiŋ hogohogok agaŋ dapmalak. Iŋgoŋ nebek niŋ kadakaniŋŋiŋ kuyaniŋgoŋ bimilat adi yadi weleŋdi kuyaniŋgoŋ nabukahilelak.”
Unduŋ yoŋa kotigoŋ tam u niŋguk, “Kadakaniŋge agaŋ tumolokutat.”
Unduŋ tubu me noli uŋoŋ ila kagiŋ adi nehi uŋgoŋ indiŋ yonadigiŋ, “Me i dediniŋ doktiŋa kadakaniŋ tumolo-tumolo tilak.”
Kaŋ Jesudi tam u niŋguk, “Nadisukilitigedi kadakaniŋ gineniŋ ganagila gehitubu-lodalak ale kulemaŋgoŋ wooŋ hatibaaŋ.”
